opening.plannedFirstBeat:
- HARD HOOK
Luca looks through toy binoculars at stars.
A beam sweeps across grass.
WHOOSH - soft POP.
Zipo drops gently into bush.
Luca: "WHAT WAS THAT?!"
Zipo pops up.
Zipo: "Blip?"
opening.sourceQuote:

A beam sweeps across grass.
opening.rationale: Yıldızlara bakan çocuğun dikkatini çeken ışın, kim geliyor sorusunu planlıyor; ilk kare tam mekanizmayı açıklamak zorunda değil.

progression.sourceQuote:
Zipo becomes sad.
Luca: "They found you?"
Zipo: "Blip."
Luca: "I'll miss you."
progression.rationale: Tanışma ve birlikte keşiften ayrılık kaygısına geçiş, izleme deneyimini daha fazla fiziksel karmaşa gerektirmeden değiştiriyor.

ending.plannedLastBeat:

Luca enters room sadly.
A small glowing stone sits on desk.
It lights up.
Zipo voice: "Blip blop, Luca!"
Luca beams.
CUT.

beats.action:
- HARD HOOK
Luca looks through toy binoculars at stars.
A beam sweeps across grass.
WHOOSH - soft POP.
Zipo drops gently into bush.
Luca: "WHAT WAS THAT?!"
Zipo pops up.
Zipo: "Blip?"

Luca kneels.
Luca: "You're an alien!"
Zipo points to Luca: "Blip blop?"
Luca: "I'm Luca."
Zipo taps chest: "Zipo!"

- EARTH TOUR
Luca shows flower. Zipo sniffs too hard and sneezes.
Luca shows ladybird. Zipo salutes it.
Luca gives biscuit. Zipo scans it before eating.
Luca: "Welcome to Pompom Hills."
Zipo: "Blip blop!"

- EMOTIONAL TURN
Larger soft blue beam appears. Zipo's wrist light flashes.
Zipo becomes sad.
Luca: "They found you?"
Zipo: "Blip."
Luca: "I'll miss you."
They hug. Zipo floats upward. Luca waves.

- TWIST
Luca enters room sadly.
A small glowing stone sits on desk.
It lights up.
Zipo voice: "Blip blop, Luca!"
Luca beams.
CUT.

No narration. No on-screen text.

originalPrompt:
Create a premium 22-25 second vertical 9:16 Pompom Hills Instagram Reel.

MAIN CHARACTER:
LUCA - official reference exactly.

GUEST:
ZIPO - original tiny friendly alien: soft mint-green skin, one large central eye, two small antennae, tiny rounded body, glowing blue wrist light. Cute, non-scary, no franchise resemblance.

SETTING:
Pompom Hills garden at night.

0.0-1.2 SEC - HARD HOOK
Luca looks through toy binoculars at stars.
A beam sweeps across grass.
WHOOSH - soft POP.
Zipo drops gently into bush.
Luca: "WHAT WAS THAT?!"
Zipo pops up.
Zipo: "Blip?"

1.2-5.0 SEC
Luca kneels.
Luca: "You're an alien!"
Zipo points to Luca: "Blip blop?"
Luca: "I'm Luca."
Zipo taps chest: "Zipo!"

5.0-11.0 SEC - EARTH TOUR
Luca shows flower. Zipo sniffs too hard and sneezes.
Luca shows ladybird. Zipo salutes it.
Luca gives biscuit. Zipo scans it before eating.
Luca: "Welcome to Pompom Hills."
Zipo: "Blip blop!"

11.0-17.0 SEC - EMOTIONAL TURN
Larger soft blue beam appears. Zipo's wrist light flashes.
Zipo becomes sad.
Luca: "They found you?"
Zipo: "Blip."
Luca: "I'll miss you."

17.0-22.0 SEC
They hug. Zipo floats upward. Luca waves.

22.0-25.0 SEC - TWIST
Luca enters room sadly.
A small glowing stone sits on desk.
It lights up.
Zipo voice: "Blip blop, Luca!"
Luca beams.
CUT.

No narration. No on-screen text.
